reference.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: style reference for modular raster IRC avatar kit, square image.
Primary request: create ONE original IRC robot operator portrait, head and shoulders, a friendly quirky oddball with cool underground hacker attitude. Pixel Operators style: crisp hand-placed-looking pixel clusters on a 64 by 64 logical grid enlarged with sharp nearest-neighbor edges, chunky terminal face, limited shading, strong silhouette.
Composition: strictly straight-on front view, bilateral alignment, square canvas. Rounded rectangular dark graphite terminal head occupies x=28%..72%, y=22%..62%. Blank charcoal screen opening x=34%..66%, y=34%..52%, with two simple welcoming eyes. Neck centered y=60%..69%. Compact shoulder chassis occupies x=25%..75%, y=65%..89%. Headset fits around head within x=22%..78%, y=18%..64%. Small bright cyan chest badge centered x=46%..54%, y=75%..82%. All essential silhouette stays inside circular avatar crop with generous margins.
Materials: neutral graphite hardware, silver edge highlights, charcoal screen; nickname cyan is confined to small chest badge; neutral pale face lights. Restrained wear. Warmly mischievous rather than aggressive.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha, no solid background, no checkerboard drawn into image.
Constraints: single character only; no letters, logos, watermark, extra props, ground shadow or scenery. Simple facial features readable as tiny avatar. This is a style reference, later components will use identical positions.
